paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV as the pruning method, showing the relative change in performance across different layer groups for various token-precision configurations. The x-axis represents layer groups labeled as Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, arranged categorically from left to right. The y-axis represents Relative Change on a linear scale ranging from approximately -25% to 5%, with tick marks at 5% intervals. A gray dashed horizontal line at 0% represents the baseline of 4×tokens at 4-bit precision. The yellow line with circle markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, remains close to 0% through Layer5-12, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer13-20, returns to near 0% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -4.5% at Layer5-12, decreases further to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately -1.5% at Layer21-28, and ends near -1% at Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -2.5% at Layer5-12, decreases sharply to approximately -12% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately -2% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts at approximately -3% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -4.5% at Layer5-12, decreases sharply to approximately -25.5% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately -5.5% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately -3% at Layer29-32. All four colored lines show a characteristic dip centered at Layer13-20, with the magnitude of the dip varying across configurations.
